limits: Only five specified saved validation JSON records, their saved configurations, frozen numerical source/protocol bytes and prior90k audit were read.
No checkpoints, models, datasets, reserved test files, training logs or particle-level predictions were loaded.
Saved calibration-bin arithmetic is checked; particle-level bin membership cannot be reconstructed from saved aggregates.
Raw dataset content hashes and native-process identity are not reverified here; saved data identity fields are covered by canonical configuration checks.
Final100k validation is audited as a saved record; this does not certify final checkpoint bytes or model execution.
Validation records share a fixed validation frame schedule despite different training seeds; no cross-seed or cross-objective performance comparison was inferred.
No later validation steps were polled or evaluated.

coordinate_mse.interpretation: Lower is better as a descriptive validation diagnostic; one paired seed only.

constant_free_gaussian_nll.interpretation: Lower is better as a descriptive validation diagnostic; one paired seed only.

binned_vector_se_calibration_gap.interpretation: Lower is better as a descriptive validation diagnostic; one paired seed only.

limits: Only the1001 logged schedule points spanning the full100k run are empirically compared, not every unlogged optimizer update. Configured host sampling/noise settings match, but actual noise arrays and every sample draw were not inspected.

Final validation means are independently reaggregated from saved frame means, and calibration-bin arithmetic is checked. Raw model outputs, Gaussian-likelihood terms and quantile bin memberships are not reconstructed.

The comparison is a single paired training seed on the fixed clean128-frame/30-trajectory validation schedule with training-noise-adjusted normalization. It is not an across-seed estimate, test result, rollout result, checkpoint-selection rule or superiority claim.
NLL has higher coordinate MSE but lower constant-free Gaussian NLL and a smaller binned vector-risk gap in this descriptive comparison. These objectives/diagnostics need not rank models identically.

The exact optimizer-update100000 UTC is not logged; completion time is the final complete-status timestamp after validation/checkpoint. Trainer timers exclude setup before initialization and are not GPU busy time, CPU core-seconds or energy.
One queue-start marker and no duplicated training records are consistent with an uninterrupted NLL invocation in the saved records; unlogged interruptions cannot be ruled out by logs alone.

Faithful elapsed retains checkpoint-lineage timing and omits recovered work/downtime already detailed in first_model_completion_audit.json. Machine contention and faithful recovery prevent a causal training-speed comparison from these durations.
Faithful duplicate losses differ after recovery despite matching logged frame/lr/count schedules; no bitwise replay claim is made.
Checkpoint digests are read from saved final pointers/status only; checkpoint bytes, raw datasets and native live process identity are not verified in this audit.
Saved source/data hashes are equal across paired configs, but source and dataset byte contents are not independently rehashed here.
